title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah offers prayers at the Bhagwan Ayyappa Temple in New Delhi
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah offers prayers at the Bhagwan Ayyappa Temple in New Delhi

Bhagwan Ayyappa is the bestower of joy and the embodiment of the sacred values that unite our nation
The Home Minister inaugurated the newly constructed SABAREESAM Complex in the temple premises
This new facility will serve as a hub for the spiritual discourses and welfare initiatives conducted by the temple
It will further strengthen the cultural roots of our brothers and sisters from Kerala

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
07 JUN 2026 9:46PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today offered prayers at the Bhagwan Ayyappa Temple in New Delhi and inaugurated the newly constructed SABAREESAM Complex in the temple premises.

In a post on X,  Union Home Minister, Shri Amit Shah said, "Fortunate to offer puja at Bhagwan Ayyappa temple, in R.K. Puram, New Delhi. Bhagwan Ayyappa is the bestower of bliss and the emodiment of the sacred values that unites our nation. Prayed to the deity for the well-being and prosperity of all.”

Fortunate to offer puja at Lord Ayyappa temple, in R.K. Puram, New Delhi.
Lord Ayyappa is the bestower of bliss and the emodiment of the sacred values that unites our nation. Prayed to the deity for the well-being and prosperity of all.

In another post, Shri Amit Shah said, “Today, at the Ayyappa Temple premises in New Delhi, inaugurated the newly built SABAREESAM Complex. The new facility will house spiritual discourses and welfare initiatives undertaken by the temple and strengthen the cultural roots of our sisters and brothers from Keralam.”
